r: Lead the identification and evaluation of new business ventures, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships that align with Group's long-term vision.

d: You will be joining an elite, specialized innovation laboratory that builds cutting-edge intelligent systems combining Artificial Intelligence, robotics, automation, and applied engineering. Operating at the forefront of industrial and digital transformation, this stealth-mode R&D facility designs scalable, real-world technologies that solve highly complex engineering challenges. They offer an intellectually stimulating, high-impact environment where top-tier product leaders, researchers, and engineers work on next-generation hardware-software integrations.

As the Product Owner, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and customer experience across both a physical smart device and its accompanying mobile application. Acting as the central link between business stakeholders, engineering, design, and subject-matter experts, you will take products from initial concept through launch and continuous post-launch iteration.
q: To qualify for this position, you must demonstrate 4–5+ years of proven, hands-on Product Ownership or Product Management experience across the following core areas:
Consumer Product Delivery: A strong track record of delivering live, consumer-facing products to real users, including taking at least one product from concept or development all the way to launch.
Agile Backlog Mastery: Hands-on ownership of product roadmaps and backlog prioritization within cross-functional teams (engineering, UX/UI design, and business).
Specification & Execution: Proven ability to author clear user stories and acceptance criteria that development teams have successfully shipped.
Metrics & Analytics: Experience defining product KPIs and leveraging customer and usage data to drive iterative product improvements.
Decision-Making & Leadership: Strong stakeholder management, decisive prioritization, and clear accountability.

Desirable Extras: Experience with connected hardware/IoT products (combining a physical device and mobile app), consumer tech/lifestyle/wellness products, AI-powered personalization, GCC product launches, vendor management, and fluency in both English and Arabic.
